# KD Labs

> KD Labs is an AI-Native Software & Open-Source Research Lab founded by Bùi Khương Duy (@kd-labs-io), building multi-agent developer tooling, zero-trust offline security applications, and applied systems engineering research.

## Products & Open Source

- [KD Code (VS Code ACP Extension)](https://kd.io.vn/apps/kd-code/): Open-source VS Code extension orchestrating multiple AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) via the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) with isolated Git Worktrees and Best-of-N diff comparison.
- [Simple OTP (100% Offline 2FA)](https://kd.io.vn/apps/simple-otp/): Zero-trust, 100% offline TOTP/HOTP two-factor authenticator for iOS and Android with AES-256-GCM hardware-backed encryption and zero network permissions.
- [GitHub Organization (@kd-labs-io)](https://github.com/kd-labs-io): Official open-source repositories and releases from KD Labs.

## Research & Technical Blog

- [KD Labs Research Blog (Vietnamese)](https://kd.io.vn/blog/): Deep-tech articles on AI Agents, ACP, Local-First CRDTs, Hardware Security Modules (HSM), Post-Quantum Cryptography, and Memory Safety.
- [KD Labs Research Blog (English)](https://kd.io.vn/en/blog/): English editions of KD Labs engineering and security research articles.

## Documentation & Policies

- [Press & Brand Kit](https://kd.io.vn/press/): Official brand guidelines, logos, and studio information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://kd.io.vn/privacy/): Zero-trust privacy and data safety policy.
- [Terms of Service](https://kd.io.vn/terms/): Terms of service for KD Labs applications and open-source software.
